name: action-queue
description: The actions and unreadable entries of the offline queue, each with its state as text and its exits. A waiting action shows as pending, never as done. Page code fills it from its queue.

parts.name: cancel
parts.description: Button that cancels a queued or stalled action.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: dismiss
parts.description: Button that removes a rejected action or an unreadable entry.

parts.name: queued
parts.description: Time when the action entered the queue.

parts.name: reason
parts.description: Reason for a refusal or an edit error.

parts.name: retry
parts.description: Button that tries a stalled action again.

parts.name: summary
parts.description: Count of actions by state or a message for an empty queue.
